id: title:dmarchuk:keep broadcast drafts with a custom recipient editable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a UI banner and workflow URL helper for draft broadcast status, and a regression test for fixed recipient addresses, supporting the broadcast workflow and wizard usability.
review.reason: Adds a route utility import, P1.F1.H1; Adds a banner for draft broadcasts and a conditional check, P1.F1.H2; Adds a test case for a fixed recipient address, P1.F2.H1.

observations.posthog_connection: Provides a helper to construct workflow URLs, which is used later in P1.F1.H2 to link the banner to the workflow editor.

observations.behavior: Adds a banner for draft broadcasts and a conditional check, P1.F1.H2
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the broadcast summary UI to show a banner when the broadcast status is draft, directing users to the workflow editor. This could help users understand why they cannot edit the broadcast in the wizard.
